tw: Patient Kron waits all day as a lazy snail paints his face.
twc: 有耐心的 Kron 等一整天，让一只懒蜗牛给他画脸。

tw: Kron builds a model ship in a bottle, and the bottle starts to wobble.
twc: Kron 在瓶子里搭了个船模，瓶子开始摇摇晃晃。
hint: 船还没下水，瓶子先晕了。

tw: Kron is cleaning the queen's green jeans, and the queen keeps singing.
twc: Kron 在清洗女王的绿色牛仔裤，女王一直在唱歌。
hint: 边洗边唱，裤子还穿着呢。

tw: Kron and two moose do the cleaning, and they lick the whole ceiling clean.
twc: Kron 和两头驼鹿一起打扫，驼鹿把天花板舔干净了。
hint: 扫除靠舌头，天花板最亮。

tw: Every Friday, Kron ties a tiny tie on each fly to keep the flies tidy.
twc: 每周五，Kron 给每只苍蝇系上小领带，让它们整整齐齐。

tw: It takes Kron ten tins of paint to paint it. Dad takes one look and faints.
twc: Kron 用了十桶漆才刷完，爸爸看一眼就晕了。

tw: Kron wants to be good at football, so he wears a wooden foot and a hood.
twc: Kron 想踢好足球，就装了只木头脚，戴上兜帽。

tw: Kron is pleased with his cheese, until ten bees sneeze on his knees.
twc: Kron 对他的奶酪很满意，直到十只蜜蜂在他膝盖上打喷嚏。
hint: 开心不过三秒，蜜蜂打喷嚏。

tw: "Have a good time," says Kron, as nine mice slide down his spine.
twc: “玩得开心！”Kron 说，九只老鼠顺他背上滑下去。
hint: 祝别人玩开心，自己当滑梯。

tw: Kron mixes fizzy drinks for Physics class, and six cans lift him up.
twc: Kron 为物理课调汽水，六罐汽水把他顶上了天。

tw: At the after-school club, Kron laughs as a calf in cool shades rules the class.
twc: 课后班上，Kron 笑看一头戴墨镜的酷小牛当班长。

tw: In preparation for the race, Kron preps ten peppers on a tray.
twc: 为了赛跑做准备，Kron 在盘子里备好十个辣椒。

tw: In the lab, Kron grabs a crab, and the crab grabs his lab coat back.
twc: Kron 在实验室抓了只螃蟹，螃蟹反手抓住他的白大褂。

tw: Kron plays all day on the playing field, using a shield for a goal.
twc: Kron 在运动场玩了一整天，拿盾牌当球门。

tw: "How many cows?" asks Kron, and many, many cows bow to him now.
twc: “有多少头牛？”Kron 问，好多好多牛冲他鞠躬。

tw: Kron puts his posh squash in the washing machine, and it spins out green and mean.
twc: Kron 把高级南瓜扔进洗衣机，转出来又绿又凶。

tw: Kron opens the fridge, and a tiny bridge of ice leads to a cold ridge.
twc: Kron 打开冰箱，里面一座冰桥通向冰冷的山脊。

tw: Kron cooks a book on the cooker, and the book turns into a cookie.
twc: Kron 把菜谱放在炉灶上煮，菜谱变成了一块饼干。
hint: 照着菜谱做，做成了菜谱饼。

tw: Kron sits on a slow sofa that goes so low it rolls into the snow.
twc: Kron 坐的沙发又慢又矮，慢慢滑进了雪里。

tw: Kron finds all kinds of balls behind the tall wall, and they all fall on him.
twc: Kron 在高墙后找到各种各样的球，球全砸在他身上。
